notes.title: CPT Update #1
notes.notes:
We made a few improvements to the character's skills for a clearer gameplay experience:
[list]
    [*]The raise path skill now raises a path of unlimited tiles once per turn - still requires a destination in order to support them.
    [*]If there are no destinations open to raise a path, the raise path button will deactivate until there is a destination available.
    [*]Added little red squares to help visualize max tile drop range.
    [*]Streamlined the game's start screen.
[/list]

That's it for this update! Let us know what you think of these changes, or if there's any ideas you might have as well. We're always open to your feedback. Thanks for your support of Coffee Pot Terrarium! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Out now on PC and Mac!
notes.notes:
After a year of development, Coffee Pot Terrarium is now available on Steam! A HUGE thanks to everyone who's been with us along the journey, and a big welcome to everyone who's taking a look for the first time.

We hope you enjoy the Coffee Pot Terrarium experience!

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes:
My brother and I have been super busy this past week adding some finishing touches and refinements to Coffee Pot Terrarium. Steam Achievements are hooked up, and the music/sfx is now balanced. We're really excited to launch CPT in just a few weeks and hope you're looking forward to the experience.

If you have any questions, be sure to let us know - we always enjoy chatting with you guys. Thanks again to everyone who's added CPT to their wishlist and have a great weekend!

Find us on Twitter for more updates and screenshots: [url=twitter.com/BrothersFlint] @BrothersFlint [/url]

notes.title: Thanks for checking out CPT!
notes.notes:
A big thanks to everyone who's added Coffee Pot Terrarium to their wishlist! Means the world to us. If you haven't added it yet, now is a great time to join the party :D

It's been a busy week for us with lots of good progress on the game. All levels are now designed and we've got some new tunes in the works. Next week we'll turn our attention to adding in Steam Achievements.

If you're interested in what we're up to, be sure to follow us on twitter: [url=twitter.com/BrothersFlint] @BrothersFlint [/url]

Have an awesome weekend!
